term: strict-part and empty candidate grounding interpretations
definition: The same Body order and all its Fusion facts admit partGround x y defined as strict parthood, and noGround x y always false. These are distinct candidate interpretations of a relation, not claims that actual metaphysical grounding is parthood or absent. Extended adds one nonmaterial nonpart candidate; externalControl asserts its nonparthood, not that it is an actual cause.
note: Analyst scope profile for #328, motivated by the materialized Varzi exposition. All-subset quantification is an explicit second-order mathematical choice; neither causal sufficiency nor metaphysical adequacy is attributed to the source. See docs/notes/universal-fusion-grounding.md.
